filter-movement-range: A yɔrɔ yɛlɛmana tuma nin na (tariku sɛbɛnnen)

filter-due-any: Ban don o don (don tɛ minnu la, olu fana b’a la)
filter-due-previous-week: A ka kan ka ban dɔgɔkun tɛmɛnen na
filter-due-next-month: A ka kan ka ban kalo nata la

filter-column-age-hint: Karti minnu donna sɛbɛn nin kɔnɔ, ni u ka don hakɛ ka ca ni hakɛ nin ye, olu dogo. Sɛbɛn wɛrɛw ni karti minnu ka donni don ma dɔn, olu bɛ to ka ye. Karti yɛlɛmani tɛ a ka mɛɛli jate daminɛ kokura sɛbɛn kɔnɔ.
filter-on-desc: I bɛ karataw sɛgɛsɛgɛ tabali in kan. Digi yan ka sɛgɛsɛgɛli yɛlɛma.
advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Karti donw woloma ni @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt walima @listEnteredAt ye. Misali: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' walima @endAt = none. I yɛrɛ ye yɔrɔ min labɛn, ni a tɔgɔ bɛ daminɛ ni @ ye, kuma taamasiyɛnw bila tɔgɔ fan fila la.
advanced-filter-description: Sɛgɛsɛgɛli ɲɛtaa bɛ yamaruya ka sɛbɛnni dɔ sɛbɛn min kɔnɔ kɛwalekɛlan ninw bɛ: == != <= >= && || ( ) Fɛn faranfansili bɛ kɛ ni yɔrɔlakolon ye kɛwalekɛlanw cɛ. I bɛ se ka foroba kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw bɛɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛ ni i ye u tɔgɔw ni u hakɛw sɛbɛn. Misali: Field1 == Value1. Kɔlɔsili: Ni yɔrɔlakolon bɛ forobaw walima hakɛw kɔnɔ, i ka u datugu tɔgɔtaamasiyɛn kelen na. Misali: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Walasa ka kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen kelen (' \/) tɛmɛ, i bɛ se ka \ kɛ. Misali: Field1 == I\'m. I bɛ se fana ka cogoya caman fara ɲɔgɔn kan. Misali: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Ka a to a la, kɛwalekɛlanw bɛ kalan ka bɔ numan na ka taa kini fɛ. I bɛ se ka labɛnni yɛlɛma ni i ye dafalenw bila. Misali: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). I bɛ se fana ka sɛbɛnni forobaw ɲini ni regex ye: F1 == /Tes.*/i
text-contains-trigger-description: A bɛnnen don ni kaatiw dara, wala ni a ka ntitre wala kɔrɔfɔli falenna, ani sɛbɛn kura in b’a la (sɛbɛn belebeleba ani fitininw tɛ danfara).
header-logo-title: Segin i ka walanw ɲɛ kan.
imported-member-no-account: Mɔgɔ ladonnen — jate bɛnnen tɛ fɔlɔ
impersonate-user: I kɛ i n'a fɔ baarakɛla
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Kanboard labɔli JSON nɔrɔ yan: fɛn min bɛ ni "columns" ye (walima baara minnu bɛ column_name la) ani "tasks" lisiti (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Columns bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye, tasks bɛ kɛ karataw ye.
import-board-instruction-deck: NextCloud Deck tabali JSON nɔrɔ yan (tabali min bɛ ni "stacks" ye, stack kelen kelen bɛ ni a ka "cards" ye). Stacks bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye, cards bɛ kɛ karataw ye.
import-board-instruction-openproject: OpenProject work-packages lajɛlen JSON nɔrɔ yan (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Statuses bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye, work packages bɛ kɛ karataw ye.
import-board-instruction-issues: __sourceName__ issues JSON lisiti nɔrɔ yan (__endpoint__). Issues bɛ kɛ karataw ye minnu labɛnnen don Open / Closed lisitiw la.
import-board-instruction-asana: Asana tasks labɔli JSON nɔrɔ yan ({ "data": [...] } Asana labɔli walima GET /tasks la). Tasks bɛ labɛn sections la (memberships); tasks minnu banna bɛ taa Done la.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: ZenKit lisiti labɔli JSON nɔrɔ yan ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye, items bɛ kɛ karataw ye.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Bila markdown baara lisi (cogo min markdown-kanban minɛnw i n'a fɔ Obsidian Kanban be baara kɛ a la): "## Lisi tɔgɔ" kunben, ni "- [ ]"/"- [x]" fɛn dow ye a jukɔrɔ. Kunben bɛ kɛ lisiw ye ani fɛnw bɛ kɛ karatiw ye; bullet lisi nɔgɔman min tɛ checkbox sɔrɔ fana bɛ don, i n'a fɔ karati dayɛlɛlen.
import-board-instruction-leo: Leo labɛn (.leo filen) nɔrɔ yan. Yɔrɔ minnu bɛ sanfɛ kɔsɛbɛ, olu bɛ kɛ sɛbɛnw ye. Yɔrɔ minnu bɛ olu jukɔrɔ kelenfɛ, olu bɛ kɛ kartiw ye, ani yɔrɔ kɔnɔ sɛbɛn bɛ kɛ karti ɲɛfɔli ye. Yɔrɔ minnu bɛ duguma ka tɛmɛ, olu bɛ kɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛli sɛbɛnw ye. Yɔrɔ minnu ma taamasiyɛn don, olu bɛ don i n'a fɔ baara minnu banna.
import-board-instruction-opml: OPML layidu don, i n'a fɔ Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq ani layidu labɛnna minɛn wɛrɛw b'a labɔ cogo min na. Fɛn minnu bɛ sanfɛ kɔrɔ, olu bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye, u denw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye ni kunnafoni ye ɲɛfɔli ye, ani fɛn minnu bɛ jukɔrɔ kosɛbɛ, olu bɛ kɛ lajɛli lisitiw ye. Fɛn dafalenw bɛ don i n'a fɔ fɛn banninw.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Org mode fisiye don, i n'a fɔ Emacs, Orgzly walima Beorg b'a sɛbɛn cogo min na. Kuntitiri minnu bɛ sanfɛ kɔrɔ, olu bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye, ani kuntitiri filanan bɛ kɛ kartiw ye. TODO ni DONE, ɲɛfɛrɔw, taamasiyɛnw, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE ani CLOSED bɛ mara, ani lajɛli butɔnw ni kuntitiri jukɔrɔlenw bɛ kɛ lajɛli lisitiw ye.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Todo.txt dosiye dɔ nɔrɔ yan: baara kelen sinsan kelen kelen bɛɛ la, i n'a fɔ todo.txt porogaramu ni porogaramu minnu bɛ bɛn a ma b'a sɛbɛn cogo min na. Baara bannenw ("x") bɛ taa Banna la, +project ni @context bɛ kɛ taamasiyɛnw ye, (A) bɛ kɛ baara fɔlɔ taamasiyɛn ye, due: ni t: bɛ kɛ laban don ni daminɛ don ye.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: task export ka bɔli nɔrɔ yan: JSON lisi dɔ walima baara kelen sɛbɛnci kelen-kelen bɛɛ la. Baara minnu banna, olu bɛ taa Done la, project ani priority bɛ kɛ taamasiyɛnw ye, annotations bɛ kɛ hakilina ye, depends bɛ kɛ da baara minnu bɛ baliya kɛ olu kan ye.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: .boardarchive filen bɔ zip kɔnɔ ani tabali ka board.jsonl kɔnɔfɛn nɔrɔ yan, ni bɔcogo sɛbɛnci ye walima ni o tɛ. Tabali lajɛcogo ka jɛkulu dilancogo bɛ kɛ lisiw ye, sugandili cogo tɔw bɛ kɛ taamasiyɛnw ye, sɛbɛnni ani taamasi da-yɔrɔw bɛ kɛ ɲɛfɔli ani sɛgɛsɛgɛli sɛbɛn ye, ani hakilinaw bɛ mara. Jaw ani filen faralenw tɛ ladon.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: MeisterTask kɔnɔ, porozɛ tɔgɔ digi, Export project sugandi ka CSV labɔ, o kɔ k'a don. Yɔrɔw bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye ani baaraw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye, ni u ka kunnafoniw, waati laban, baarakɛla ani taamasiyɛnw ye; baara dafalenw b'u dafali don mara. CSV min sɛbɛnna MeisterTask yɛrɛ ka donni kama, o fana bɛ baara kɛ.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Obsidian kɔnɔ, Kanban walan fisiye da wuli i n'a fɔ Markdown (walima .md fisiye da wuli sɛbɛnni labɛnnan kɔnɔ), o kɔ a bɛɛ don. Siraw bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye ni u ka karti dan ye, kartiw b'u ka taamasiyɛnw, donw, ɲɛfɛrɔ, forow ani lajɛli lisiti mara, ani Archive bɛ kɛ karti bilalenw ye marayɔrɔ la.
import-board-instruction-linear: Linear kɔnɔ, gɛlɛyaw labɔ i n'a fɔ CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, walima lajɛyɔrɔ dɔ ka labɔli), o kɔ CSV don. Cogoyaw bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye, jɛkuluw bɛ kɛ siraw ye, ani gɛlɛyaw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye ni u ka baarakɛla, taamasiyɛnw, donw, gɛlɛya faden, ɲɛfɛrɔ, jateminɛ, porozɛ ani tasuma ye.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: TickTick kɔnɔ, Settings, Account, Backup & Import da wuli ka kopi dɔ dilan, o kɔ CSV fisiye don. TickTick lisiti kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ kɛ sira ye ani a ka kolɔnw bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye; baaraw b'u ka taamasiyɛnw, donw, lajɛli lisiti, ɲɛfɛrɔ ani baara fitininw mara.
import-board-instruction-clickup: ClickUp kɔnɔ, baaraw labɔ i n'a fɔ CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, walima List walima Table lajɛyɔrɔ ka labɔli ni kolɔn bɛɛ ye), o kɔ CSV don. Cogoyaw bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye, ClickUp lisitiw bɛ kɛ siraw ye, ani baaraw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye ni u ka baara fitininw, baarakɛlaw, taamasiyɛnw, donw, ɲɛfɛrɔ ani waati ye.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Nullboard kɔnɔ, walan da wuli, Export this board... sugandi menu kɔnɔ, .nbx fisiye da wuli sɛbɛnni labɛnnan kɔnɔ ka a kɔnɔkofɛnw don. Lisitiw bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye ani kunnafoniw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye: kunnafoni ka sira fɔlɔ ye karti tɔgɔ ye ani a tɔ ye a ɲɛfɔli ye. Kunnafoni kɛnɛ bɛ taamasiyɛn raw sɔrɔ. Fisiye min kɔnɔ walan caman bɛ, o ka walan fɔlɔ dɔrɔn bɛ don.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Kanri kɔnɔ, Import & Export da wuli ka Export individual board sugandi (walima Export all data), o kɔ .json fisiye don. Kolɔnw bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye ani kartiw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye, ni u ka ɲɛfɔli, waati laban, taamasiyɛnw ani kulɛriw ye; karti ka baaraw bɛ kɛ lajɛli lisiti ye. Ni a bɛɛ labɔra, walan fɔlɔ de bɛ don.
import-board-instruction-planka: I ka Planka ka adresi sɛbɛn (misali la https://planka.example.com), i ka Planka baarakɛla tɔgɔ ani gundo daɲɛ, o kɔ i ka Sɛbɛn jira digi. U bɛ baara kɛ walan ta dɔrɔn de kama, u tɛ mara. Walan dɔ sugandi ka Ta digi: WeKan b'a kalan ka bɔ Planka ka API la, a ka sɛbɛnw, kartiw, ɲɛfɔliw, waati labanw, taamasiyɛnw, tɔndenw, baara sɛbɛnw ani hakilinaw fana, o kɔ i ka donni taa ɲɛ i n'a fɔ tuma bɛɛ. Kartiw minnu bɛ Planka ka marayɔrɔ la, olu bɛ don marali la; nɔrɔlenw ani kartiw minnu bɛ nɔgɔ bɔlɔ kɔnɔ, olu tɛ don.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer) kɔnɔ, i don, i sɔn Tasks.Read sira ma ani ka token ladege ka bɔ Access token tab la. A da yan ka Sɛbɛn jira digi; token bɛ baara kɛ nin tali in dɔrɔn kama, a tɛ mara. Sɛbɛnw bɛɛ walima sɛbɛn kelen sugandi ka Ta digi. To Do sɛbɛn kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ kɛ sɛbɛn ye, baara kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ kɛ karti ye, a ka notiw, waati laban ni daminɛ don, senw i n'a fɔ sɛgɛsɛgɛli sɛbɛn, sugu i n'a fɔ taamasiyɛnw, ani nafa ba ni cogoya i n'a fɔ taamasiyɛnw; baara bannenw bɛ mara. Hakilijigiw ni seginniw tɛ don.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: KanbanFlow kɔnɔ, walan ka menu da wuli, Settings → API & Webhooks sugandi ani ka walan ka API token ladege. Token da yan, Sɛbɛn jira digi, walan sugandi ka Ta digi; token bɛ baara kɛ o tali dɔrɔn kama, a tɛ mara. Kolonw bɛ kɛ sɛbɛnw ye, siraw bɛ to siraw ye; baaraw bɛ u ka ɲɛfɔli, u ka ɲɛgɛn, taamasiyɛnw, waati laban, baara misɛnw i n'a fɔ sɛgɛsɛgɛli sɛbɛn, waati min tɛmɛna, jateminɛ, mɔgɔw ani hakilinaw mara.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: I ka Basecamp jatebɔsɛbɛn ID sɛbɛn (nimɔrɔ min bɛ basecamp.com/ kɔ adresi kɔnɔ) ani donni token (ka bɔ OAuth 2 app dɔ la min sɛbɛnna launchpad.37signals.com kan, walima min bɛ integration dɔ bolo kaban), Sɛbɛn jira digi, porozɛ dɔ sugandi ka Ta digi. Token bɛ baara kɛ o tali dɔrɔn kama, a tɛ mara. Karti tabali kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ kɛ sira ye a ka kolonw ye sɛbɛnw ye, ani baara kɛtaw ka sɛbɛnw bɛ kɛ To-dos sira ye; kartiw ni baara kɛtaw bɛ u ka sɛbɛn, u ka donw, mɔgɔ minnu ye u ta ani hakilinaw mara, karti ka senw bɛ kɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛli sɛbɛn ye, ani baara bannenw bɛ mara.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: Donni token sɔrɔ OAuth 2.0 Playground la: Tasks API v1 kɔrɔ tasks.readonly sugandi, Authorize APIs digi, o kɔ Exchange authorization code for tokens, ani ka donni token ladege. A da yan ka Sɛbɛn jira digi, baara sɛbɛnw bɛɛ walima kelen sugandi, o kɔ Ta. Token bɛ baara kɛ nin tali in dɔrɔn kama, a tɛ mara. Baara sɛbɛnw bɛ kɛ sɛbɛnw ye, baaraw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye, u ka notiw, u ka jɛɲɔgɔnyaw ani waati laban; baara misɛnw bɛ kɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛli sɛbɛn ye, baara bannenw bɛ don marali la.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: Google Keep ka API ye Google Workspace jatebɔsɛbɛnw dɔrɔn de ta ye. OAuth 2.0 donni token sɔrɔ ni scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly ye (OAuth 2.0 Playground kɔnɔ ni i ka Workspace kuntigi sɔnna a ma, walima ka bɔ baarakɛyɔrɔ jatebɔsɛbɛn dɔ la min ye domɛni bɛɛ fanga sɔrɔ), a da, Sɛbɛn jira digi ani o kɔ Ta. Token bɛ baara kɛ nin tali in dɔrɔn kama, a tɛ mara. Sɛbɛn notiw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye Notiw sɛbɛn kɔnɔ, ani sɛgɛsɛgɛli notiw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye Sɛbɛnw sɛbɛn kɔnɔ u ka fɛnw ye sɛgɛsɛgɛli sɛbɛn ye. Notiw minnu bɛ nɔgɔ bɔlɔ kɔnɔ, nɔrɔlenw ani tilali tɛ don.
api-import-desc: A ta ka bɔ baarakɛyɔrɔ la ni i yɛrɛ ka jatebɔsɛbɛn ye. I bɛ min sɛbɛn yan, o bɛ baara kɛ nin tali in dɔrɔn kama, a tɛ mara.
api-import-list: Sɛbɛn jira: min bɛ se ka don
api-import-fetched: A tara. Tɔnden minnu bɛ duguma, olu lajɛ ka don.
api-import-nothing: Foyi tɛ yen ka don ni nin jatebɔsɛbɛn ye.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Pivotal Tracker kɔnɔ, porozɛ ka MORE tabulo da wuli ka Export CSV sugandi (walima maana dɔw sugandi ka Bulk Actions, CSV sugandi), o kɔ CSV don. Maana cogoya kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ kɛ lisiti ye ani maanaw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye, ni u ka suguya ni taamasiyɛnw, tigiw, ɲinibaga, donw, hakilinaw, baaraw ani bolilankolonw ye; Estimate bɛ kɛ Story points ye ani tasumaw bɛ kɛ sprintw ye.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Tasks.org kɔnɔ, Settings, Backups da wuli ka Export tasks sugandi, o kɔ o .json fisiye kɔnɔkofɛnw don. Lisitiw bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye ani baaraw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye, ni u ka kunnafoniw, taamasiyɛnw, donw, hakilinaw ani baara fitininw ye; baara dafalenw b'u dafali don mara, ani ɲɛfɛrɔ bɛ kɛ foro kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen ye.
import-board-instruction-monday: monday.com kɔnɔ, walan menu da wuli, More actions ni Export board to Excel sugandi (ni kunnafoni kuraw ni fɛn fitininw ye ni i b'a fɛ), o kɔ o .xlsx fisiye sugandi. Status kolɔn bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye ani kuluw bɛ kɛ siraw ye; mɔgɔw, donw, waati sira ani taamasiyɛnw b'u nɔ mara, kolɔn wɛrɛw bɛ kɛ foro kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw ye ani kunnafoni kuraw bɛ kɛ hakilinaw ye.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Super Productivity kɔnɔ, Settings da wuli, o kɔ Sync & Backup, Export Data sugandi ka sp-backup .json fisiye kɔnɔkofɛnw don. Porozɛ kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ kɛ sira ye ani baaraw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye To Do, In Progress, Backlog walima Done kɔnɔ, ni u ka kunnafoniw, taamasiyɛnw, waati laban, waati min tɛmɛna ani baara fitininw ye; baara bilalenw marayɔrɔ la bɛ kɛ karti bilalenw ye marayɔrɔ la.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Taiga kɔnɔ, Admin > Project > Export da wuli ka porozɛ kopi jigin (.json.gz fisiye dabɔ fɔlɔ), o kɔ a ka JSON don. User story cogoyaw bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye, user storyw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye ni u ka baaraw ye i n'a fɔ baara fitininw, epicw ni gɛlɛyaw b'u yɛrɛ ka siraw sɔrɔ, ani sprintw, taamasiyɛnw, hakilinaw ani jogo kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw bɛ na fana. Nɔrɔlenw tɛ don.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Vikunja kɔnɔ, Settings da wuli, Data Export sugandi ka .zip fisiye min ci i ma jigin, o kɔ o fisiye sugandi, walima data.json min bɛ a kɔnɔ, o don. Kanban bɔɔrɔw bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye ani baaraw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye, ni u ka taamasiyɛnw, baarakɛlaw, donw, ɲɛfɔli, baara lisitiw i n'a fɔ lajɛli lisitiw ani hakilinaw ye; ɲɛfɛrɔ, kɛmɛsarada dafalen ani dafalen bɛ kɛ foro kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw ye. Nɔrɔlenw tɛ don.
import-board-instruction-quire: Quire kɔnɔ, porozɛ menu da wuli ka Export CSV sugandi, o kɔ CSV don. Cogoyaw bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye ani baaraw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye, ni u ka baara fitininw ye i n'a fɔ karti denw, baarakɛlaw, taamasiyɛnw i n'a fɔ labelw, daminɛ, laban ani dafali donw, ɲɛfɔli ani ɲɛfɛrɔ i n'a fɔ foro kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen. Hakilinaw ni nɔrɔlenw tɛ Quire ka CSV kɔnɔ.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Wrike kɔnɔ, porozɛ walima kɛsu labɔ Excel la, walima Wrike ka Excel donni misali fa, o kɔ o .xlsx fisiye sugandi. Kɛsu ni porozɛ siraw bɛ kɛ siraw ye, Status bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye ani baaraw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye, ni u ka Key, baara faden, baarakɛlaw, daminɛ ni laban donw, sirilenw ani ɲɛfɔli ye; Priority, Duration ani kolɔn wɛrɛw bɛ kɛ foro kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw ye.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Teamwork.com kɔnɔ, Excel baara donni misali fa (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) ka a mara i n'a fɔ .xlsx, o kɔ o fisiye sugandi. Baara lisitiw bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye ani baaraw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye; baara min bɛ daminɛ ni -, # walima > ye, o bɛ kɛ a sanfɛ baara ka baara fitini ye (--, ## walima >> ka jigin dakun kelen). Baarakɛlaw, donw ani taamasiyɛnw b'u nɔ mara; Priority, Estimated time ani Complete bɛ kɛ foro kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw ye.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Businessmap (Kanbanize kɔrɔ) kɔnɔ, Advanced Search da wuli, Configure results sugandi ka kolɔnw sugandi, Excel fisiye jigin, o kɔ o .xlsx fisiye sugandi. Kolɔnw bɛ kalan u ka angilɛkan tɔgɔw la (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): ni i ka jatebila bɛ kan wɛrɛ kɛ, kuntitiri sira tɔgɔ yɛlɛma ka kɛ angilɛkan ye fɔlɔ. Column bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye ani Lane bɛ kɛ siraw ye; tigiw, taamasiyɛnw, kulɛri, donw, hakilinaw ani faden sirajɛw b'u nɔ mara, ani Priority, Size, Type ani kolɔn wɛrɛw bɛ kɛ foro kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw ye.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Redmine kɔnɔ, porozɛ ka Issues da wuli, Also available in: CSV sugandi lisiti duguma, kolɔnw sugandi (All columns, ni Description ye) ka a labɔ, o kɔ CSV don. Redmine bɛ kolɔnw tɔgɔ da i ka kan na, o la i ka kan sigi angilɛkan na My account kɔnɔ sani i ka a labɔ. Cogoya kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ kɛ lisiti ye ani gɛlɛyaw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye, ni tracker ye i n'a fɔ taamasiyɛn, baarakɛla, sɛbɛnbaga, donw, baara faden ani gɛlɛya sirilenw; ɲɛfɛrɔ, suguya, version laɲinilen, waati jatelen, % Done ani foro kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw bɛ kɛ foro kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw ye.
import-board-instruction-notion: Notion kɔnɔ, kunnafonimarayɔrɔ da wuli i n'a fɔ ɲɛ dafalen, ••• ni Export sugandi, Markdown & CSV sugandi, ani .zip fisiye min jiginna, o sugandi, walima kunnafonimarayɔrɔ CSV kelen min bɛ a kɔnɔ, walima o CSV don. Kolɔn min tɔgɔ ye Status, o bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye (ni o tɛ yen, kolɔn fɔlɔ min bɛ i n'a fɔ sugandili, o bɛ kɛ, ani donni rapɔɔri b'a fɔ min don); sirandaw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye ni u tɔgɔ, taamasiyɛnw i n'a fɔ labelw, mɔgɔw i n'a fɔ tɔndenw, donw, ani ɲɛ sɛbɛnni i n'a fɔ ɲɛfɔli; kolɔn wɛrɛw bɛ kɛ foro kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw ye. Jɛɲɔgɔnyaw, jaw ani nɔrɔlenw tɛ don.
import-board-instruction-plane: Plane kɔnɔ, Workspace Settings da wuli, Exports sugandi, porozɛw labɔ i n'a fɔ JSON, CSV walima Excel ka .zip fisiye jigin, o kɔ o fisiye sugandi, walima fisiye kelen min bɛ a kɔnɔ, walima JSON walima CSV don. Cogoyaw bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye, porozɛw bɛ kɛ siraw ye, ani gɛlɛyaw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye ni u ka dɔnnikɛtaamasiyɛn, faden, baarakɛlaw, taamasiyɛnw, donw, sirajɛw ani hakilinaw ye; ɲɛfɛrɔ, jateminɛ, tasuma ani module bɛ kɛ foro kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw ye. Plane ka labɔli tɛ ni ɲɛfɔliw walima nɔrɔlenw ye, o la u tɛ don.
import-board-instruction-trello: I ka Trello tabali la, taa 'Menu', o kɔ 'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', ka sɛbɛnni min bɔra, o bɔ kopi.
import-board-instruction-csv: I ka Comma Separated Values(CSV)/ Tab Separated Values (TSV) nɔrɔ yan.
import-board-instruction-jira: Jira Cloud REST API issue search JSON nɔrɔ yan (GET /rest/api/3/search/jql), walima { "issues": [...] } fɛn bɛnnen. Jira statuses bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye, issues bɛ kɛ karataw ye. I bɛ se ka "automationRules" lisiti fara a kan ka sariyaw ladon.
import-board-instruction-excel: WeKan cogoya .xlsx tabali sɛbɛn sugandi (columns kelen Excel labɔli ni: Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, dates, custom fields). Sira fɔlɔ ye tɔgɔsiraw ye.
import-board-instruction-wekan: I ka tabali la, taa 'Menu', o kɔ 'Export board', ka sɛbɛnni bɔ kopi dosiye lajiginnen kɔnɔ.
import-board-instruction-about-errors: Ni fili sɔrɔra tabali ladonni la, ladonni bɛ baara tuma dɔw la hali ni o ye, wa tabali bɛ Tabali Bɛɛ ɲɛ kan.

csv-mapping-custom-fields: Kolɔn wɛrɛw minnu ka kan ka don i n'a fɔ sɛbɛnni foro kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw:

rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Imɛli nin taamasiyɛn kɛ ko a cilen don bɛɛ ma? O kɛ ni i b'a dɔn ko a sera dɔrɔn.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Imɛli nin cilen dabila? A tɛna ci minɛbaga minnu ka sɔrɔli ma lakika fɔlɔ ma.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: Cili fɔlɔ bɛ se ka to ka kɛ. A lajɛ tuguni kɔfɛ.
rule-email-resolution-already-resolved: Imɛli nin ko ɲɛnabɔra ka ban.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Cili tuguni min kɛra kɔrɔ bɛ se ka to ka kɛ. A lajɛ tuguni kɔfɛ.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Minɛbaga bɛɛ ka sɔrɔli lakikara ka ban. A taamasiyɛn kɛ ko a cilen don o nɔ na.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: Imɛli sɛrivɛri ma jaabi di. Imɛli min cira tuguni, a bɛ se ka a sɔrɔ ko a sera walima a ma se; a bɛ jira i n'a fɔ a bɛ ka kɛ hali bi.
rule-email-resolution-busy: Kuntigi wɛrɛ bɛ imɛli nin ko ɲɛnabɔ. A lajɛ tuguni waati dɔɔnin kɔfɛ.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: Imɛli maralen tɛ bɛn nin lajɛli ma tuguni, o la a ko tɛ se ka ɲɛnabɔ yan.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Nin lajɛli kunnafoni maralenw ma bɛn, o la a ko tɛ se ka ɲɛnabɔ yan.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Imɛli nin ko ma se ka ɲɛnabɔ. Ɲɛ in dayɛlɛ tuguni ka a lajɛ tuguni.
rule-email-legacy-heading: Sariya imɛli minnu bɛ lajɛli makɔnɔ
rule-email-legacy-description: Nin sariya imɛliw labɛnna WeKan sugu kɔrɔ dɔ fɛ min ma u kɔnɔkow bɔyɔrɔ sɛbɛn, o la WeKan tɛna u ci a yɛrɛ ma. A lajɛ fɔlɔ ni sariya dabɔbaga ka donni yamaruya bɛ a bolo hali bi, o kɔfɛ imɛli siri tuguni walasa ka a labɛn tuguni ka bɔ karti cogo la sisan, walima a fili.
rule-email-legacy-reason-details-snapsho: Karti kunnafoni minnu bɔra sugu kɔrɔ dɔ la
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Imɛli nin labɛn tuguni ka bɔ karti cogo la sisan? A kɔnɔko bɛ se ka danfara a ni min labɛnna kɔrɔ cɛ.
rule-email-legacy-discard-confirm: Imɛli nin fili? A tɛna ci abada.
rule-email-legacy-empty: Sariya imɛli si tɛ lajɛli makɔnɔ.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Sariya imɛli minnu bɛ lajɛli makɔnɔ ma se ka don. Ɲɛ in dayɛlɛ tuguni walasa ka a lajɛ tuguni.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Sariya dabɔbaga ka donni yamaruya tɛ nin karti la tuguni, walima sariya yɛlɛmana, o la imɛli tɛ se ka siri tuguni. I bɛ se ka a fili.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Kɛwale min ye nin imɛli daminɛ yɛlɛmana, o la a tɛ se ka siri tuguni. I bɛ se ka a fili.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Karti min na nin imɛli bɔra tɛ yen tuguni, o la a tɛ se ka siri tuguni. I bɛ se ka a fili.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Sariya waleyali min ye nin imɛli labɛn tɛ maralen ye tuguni, o la a tɛ se ka siri tuguni. I bɛ se ka a fili.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Imɛli nin cira ka ban, a cili lajɛra ka ban, walima a filila ka ban.
rule-email-legacy-not-legacy: Imɛli nin sirira tuguni ka ban.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Nin kɛwale ma se ka ban. Ɲɛ in dayɛlɛ tuguni ka a lajɛ tuguni.
stuck-sync-operation-heading: Lisiti bɛnkanni baara minnu tɛ se ka kɛ tugun
stuck-sync-operation-description: Lisiti bɛnkanni baara maralen ninnu kelen-kelen bɛɛ jɔra sira cɛ la ka a sɔrɔ a tɛ se ka dafa tun, bawo a ka lisiti bɔra, a dilanna kokura walima a labɛnna kokura, walima baarakɛla min y'a daminɛ, o ka sɛbɛnni sira tununna. K'a sɔrɔ kelen bɛ makɔnɔ, o lisiti tɛ se ka bɛnkan. A bila walasa lisiti ka se ka bɛnkan tugun: yɛlɛma minnu kɛra kaban, olu bɛ to, yɛlɛma maralen tolenw tɛ sɛbɛn abada, ani bɛnkanni nata bɛ lisiti suma a bɔyɔrɔ la tugun.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: Lisiti bɔra, a dilanna kokura walima a ka bɛnkanni labɛnw yɛlɛmana
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: Baarakɛla min y'a daminɛ, o tɛ ni sɛbɛnni sira ye lisiti bɛɛ kan tun
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: A marara WeKan version kɔrɔ dɔ fɛ k'a sɔrɔ min y'a daminɛ, o ma sɛbɛn
stuck-sync-operation-reason-intent-missi: Mɔgɔ min y'a daminɛ, o sɛbɛn tɛ yen
stuck-sync-operation-reason-unknown: A ma se ka lajɛ sisan
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: A bɛ se ka kɛ tugun sisan ani a bɛna ban a yɛrɛ ma, o la a tɛ se ka bila.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Nin lisiti bɛnkanni baara maralen bila wa? Yɛlɛma minnu kɛra a fɛ kaban, olu bɛ to; tɔw tɛ sɛbɛn abada. O kɔ lisiti bɛ se ka bɛnkan tugun.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: Lisiti bɛnkanni baara si tɛ lajɛli makɔnɔ.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: A kɔrɔw 50 dɔrɔn de bɛ jira. Dɔw bila ka a kuraya walasa ka caman ye.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: Lisiti bɛnkanni baaraw ma se ka lado. A kuraya ka a kɛ tugun.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: Nin baara ma sɔrɔ jɔlen, o la a tɛ se ka bila.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: Nin baara bɛ se ka kɛ tugun sisan ani a bɛna ban a yɛrɛ ma, o la a ma bila.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: Nin lisiti bɛ ka bɛnkan sisan. A kɛ tugun waati dɔɔnin kɔfɛ.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Nin kɛwale ma se ka ban. Ɲɛ in dayɛlɛ tuguni ka a lajɛ tuguni.
interrupted-import-heading: Walan donni minnu jɔra sani u ka ban
interrupted-import-description: Walan donni ninnu kelen-kelen bɛɛ jɔra sira cɛ la - sɛriwɛri lawulira kokura, walima donni ma se - ka walan dɔɔnin to yen. Donni tɛ se ka taa a fɛ, bawo a bɔyɔrɔ fisiye tɛ mara. Walan to a cogo la, walima a bila ka fisiye don tugun. Bilali bɛ nin donni ye walan min dilan, o bɔ ani fɛn bɛɛ min bɛ a kan, ka fara fɛn bɛɛ kan minnu farala a kan kabini.
interrupted-import-created: Min dilanna ka se sisan ma
interrupted-import-state-stopped: A jɔra k'a sɔrɔ a ma ban, __stage__ la
interrupted-import-state-failed: A ma se ni __error__ ye, __stage__ la
interrupted-import-state-discarding: A bɛ ka bila; a bila tugun walasa k'a ban
interrupted-import-scrum: A ka Scrum yɔrɔ bɛ ni a yɛrɛ ka lajɛyɔrɔ ye (__state__, taabolo __next__ __total__ la). Ni i ye walan mara, a ban walima a bila ka bɔ walan ka Scrum donni segin na.
interrupted-import-counts: sira __swimlanes__, lisiti __lists__, karti __cards__, lajɛli lisiti __checklists__, hakilina __comments__, nɔrɔlen __attachments__
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Nin walan dɔɔnin to a cogo la wa? Foyi tɛ bɔ, ani donni tɛ sɛbɛn yan tun.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Nin donni bila wa? Walan min dilanna a fɛ ani fɛn bɛɛ min bɛ a kan, olu bɛ bɔ pewu.
interrupted-import-empty: Walan donni tigɛlen si tɛ lajɛli makɔnɔ.
interrupted-import-truncated: A kɔrɔw 50 dɔrɔn de bɛ jira. Dɔw mara walima u bila ka a kuraya walasa ka caman ye.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Walan donni tigɛlenw ma se ka lado. A kuraya ka a kɛ tugun.
interrupted-import-not-interrupted: Nin donni tɛ latigɛ makɔnɔ tun.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: Walan min ID ye nin ye, o ma dilan nin donni fɛ, o la a ma maga.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: A ka Scrum yɔrɔ bɛ ka sɛbɛn walima ka segin hali bi. A kɛ tugun miniti dɔɔnin kɔfɛ.
interrupted-import-failed: Nin kɛwale ma se ka ban. Ɲɛ in dayɛlɛ tuguni ka a lajɛ tuguni.
saml-login-not-started: Nin SAML donni ma daminɛ nin navigatɛri taabu kɔnɔ. I ka don kokura, n b’i deli.
history-request-pending-undo: Jɔyɔrɔ-masina ma i ka fɛn yɛlɛma laban laseginni sɛbɛya fɔlɔ.
history-request-pending-redo: Jɔyɔrɔ-masina ma i ka fɛn yɛlɛma laban kɛli kokura sɛbɛya fɔlɔ.
history-request-hint: Ni i ye a lajɛ kokura, ɲininkali kelen de bɛ ci tuguni, o la a tɛ se ka fɛn yɛlɛma filanan lasegin abada.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: Scrum yɛlɛmaw segin kɔ, u kɛ tugun walima u lasegin, o jɔra sɔsɔli dɔ kan. Scrum yɛlɛmaliw bilalen don nin walan kan fo a ka ɲɛnabɔ.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: Yɛlɛma __applied__ sɛbɛnna __total__ la, __pending__ ma sɛbɛn, ani __conflicted__ yɛlɛmana mɔgɔ wɛrɛ fɛ kabini.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Segin kɔ bɛ sɛbɛn yɛlɛmanen bɛɛ segin a cogo fɔlɔ la; a bɛ di dɔrɔn ni mɔgɔ wɛrɛ si ma o sɛbɛnw yɛlɛma kabini. Walan to a cogo la, o bɛ baara jɔlen bɔ, sɛbɛn si tɛ yɛlɛma. O cogo o cogo, a bɛ sɛbɛn Admin Panel, Problems, Recovery kɔnɔ.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Sɛbɛn bɛɛ to a cogo la sisan, ka fara yɛlɛmaw kan baara jɔlen ye minnu sɛbɛn kaban wa?
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: Walan ɲɛmɔgɔ bɛ se k'a segin kɔ walima ka walan to a cogo la.
login-setting-clear-secret: Sɔngɔ min maralen bɛ ɲɛmɔgɔ ka walan kan, o bɔ yen

login-setting-env-only: Sɛriwɛri sigiyɔrɔ dɔrɔn de bɛ ninnu sigi. U bɛ jira yan kalan dɔrɔn kama.
email-to-card-description: Imɛli min ci ka taa i ka walan ladɛrɛsi la, o bɛ kɛ karti ye o walan kan.

email-to-card-add-imap: IMAP imɛli bataki fara a kan

email-to-card-sandstorm-board-none: Foyi - imɛli minnu kunnafoni kun na walan token bɛ, olu dɔrɔn
email-to-card-sandstorm-subject: Nin bila kunnafoni kun na walasa ka se nin walan ma i yɛrɛ tɔgɔ la:
email-to-card-parts: Imɛli yɔrɔ minnu bɛ baara la
email-to-card-part-description: Imɛli kɔnɔkow ka kɛ karti ɲɛfɔli ye
email-to-card-part-strip-quoted: Cikan kɔrɔ minnu ɲɛfɔra, olu bila kɛrɛfɛ
email-to-card-your-address: I ka imɛli ladɛrɛsi nin walan kama
email-to-card-address-private: A mara gundo la: mɔgɔ o mɔgɔ b'a fɛ, o bɛ se ka kartiw fara a kan i tɔgɔ la.

email-to-card-member-enabled: Ne ka walan ladɛrɛsiw bɛ baara kɛ
email-to-card-off-admin-off: Imɛliw minɛni ma labɛn Ɲɛmɔgɔ ka walan kɔnɔ.
email-to-card-off-board-off: Walan ɲɛmɔgɔ ma imɛli daminɛ nin walan kama.
email-to-card-off-member-off: I ye i ka walan ladɛrɛsiw dabila Tɔnden labɛnw kɔnɔ.
email-to-card-off-sandstorm-no-session: Grain nin ma a ka imɛli ladɛrɛsi sɔrɔ fɔlɔ. Ɲɛ kura labɔ.
email-to-card-off-not-authorized: Sɛbɛnni sira ka kan ka kɛ i bolo nin walan kan.
inbound-domain-invalid: O tɛ domɛni tɔgɔ ɲuman ye.
inbound-account-invalid: IMAP imɛli bataki mago bɛ sɛriwɛri tɔgɔ ɲuman na.
feature-views-email-desc: Walan bɛ i n'a fɔ bataki bɔrɔ: imɛli sɛbɛn ye Nalenw ye, sɛbɛnw ye kɔrɔw ye, taamasiyɛnw ye taamasiyɛnw ye, tɔnden bɛ imɛli sɛbɛn ani ka jaabi di ka bɔ walan ka adirɛsi la.
email-view-not-receiving: Nin walan tɛ imɛli minɛ fɔlɔ. A daminɛ walan ka Kunnafonidi labɛnw → Imɛli ka kɛ karti ye kɔnɔ.
email-view-invalid-address: Adirɛsi kelen tɛ imɛli adirɛsi ɲuman ye.
email-view-no-recipient: Minɛbaga kelen fara a kan dɔɔnin.
email-view-too-many: Imɛli caman cira lɛrɛ laban kɔnɔ. A lajɛ tugun kɔfɛ.
email-view-no-list: Walan mago bɛ sɛbɛn na imɛli kama.
feature-views-chat-desc: Walan bɛ i n'a fɔ baro baara yɔrɔ: baara yɔrɔw, walanw, siraw, sɛbɛnw ani kartiw i n'a fɔ kanaliw jiri, karti bɛ cɛmancɛ la ani a hakilinaw ye baro cikanw ye.
chat-view-message-cards: Karti minnu bɛ cikanw na, olu dɔrɔn jira
chat-view-resize: A sama ka a bonya wala ka a dɔgɔya
chat-view-pick-card: Karti dɔ sugandi kanaliw la walasa k'a ye yan.
chat-view-no-messages: Cikan si tɛ yen fɔlɔ. Fɔlɔ sɛbɛn.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Karti kelenw kolonw kulu caman na minnu tɔgɔ bɛ - ka kɛɲɛ ni banni, ɲɛfɛtaa, sanga walima fɛn wɛrɛ ye - u bɛ lamaga kolonw cɛ ni u sama ye.
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Tabulo menu → Sariyaw bɛ sariyaw laɲini ka bɔ mɔgɔw bɛ min kɛ ni bolo ye tuma bɛɛ.
feature-board-summary-desc: Tabulo menu → Kuncɛli bɛ mɔgɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka baara jira tabulo kan tile laban walima dɔgɔkun laban na, ani min waati tɛmɛna.
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Tabulo menu → Kabini i ka taali laban bɛ mɔgɔ wɛrɛw ka yɛlɛmaliw jira tabulo kan.
feature-search-phrases-desc: Ɲinini bɛɛ bɛ kumasen nɔgɔmanw faamu i n'a fɔ "n ka karti minnu waati tɛmɛna".
column-sets-empty: Kolon kulu si tɛ yen fɔlɔ. Walan baarakɛla kuntigi bɛ se ka kelen dilan: tɔgɔ d'a ma, o kɔ k'a kolonw fara a kan.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Tabali i ko GitHub walima Gitea gɛlɛya kɔlɔsibaga: kartiw i ko gɛlɛyaw, taamasiyɛnw ni sanfɛyɔrɔw, hakilinaw i ko baro, nɔrɔlenw i ko dosiyew, ani tabali tariku ni seginni.
vcs-no-issues: Gɛlɛya si tɛ bɛn ɲini in ma.
vcs-no-milestones: Sanfɛyɔrɔ si tɛ yen fɔlɔ. Taamasiyɛn min ni waati laban bɛ, o ye sanfɛyɔrɔ ye.
vcs-issue-title-required: Gɛlɛya mago bɛ kunnafoni kuntigi la.
vcs-no-list: Lisi walima sira si tɛ tabali in na gɛlɛya kama.
card-qr-code-desc: A sɛgɛsɛgɛ walasa ka karti in dayɛlɛ telefɔni walima tablɛti kan.
card-qr-code-too-long: Karti in jɛ ka jan kojugu QR kode kama.
vcs-no-wiki: Wiki si tɛ yen fɔlɔ. GitHub jɛkulu donni bɛ repository ka wiki lase yan.
github-org-import-desc: Jɛkulu walima baarakɛla ka repository kelen kelen bɛɛ bɛ kɛ walan ye, min bɛ da Board View / Version Control kɔnɔ: a gɛlɛyaw ni u hakilinaw, taamasiyɛnw ani dosiyew, a bɔlenw, a ka GitHub Actions baarasiraw i n'a fɔ Sariyaw, ani a ka wiki.
github-org-import-token-hint: A ka kan repository dogolenw ni API dan kɔrɔtalen kama. A bɛ baara kɛ donni senfɛ dɔrɔn, a tɛ mara abada.
github-org-import-issues: Gɛlɛyaw, ni hakilinaw, taamasiyɛnw ani dosiyew ye
github-org-import-release-files: Bɔlen dosiyew (u bɛ se ka bonya)
github-org-import-actions: GitHub Actions baarasiraw i n'a fɔ Sariyaw
github-org-import-owner-invalid: Jɛkulu walima baarakɛla tɔgɔ sɛbɛn, walima a ka GitHub adirisi.
github-org-import-no-repos: Repository si tɛ yen ka don.
github-org-import-running: Jɛkulu donni dɔ bɛ ka kɛ kaban.
optional-apis-desc: REST API minnu bɛ i n'a fɔ tɛmɛsira tɔw ka API, walasa u ka application ni script bɛ se ka nin WeKan in kɛ u ka backend ye: u bɛ min mara, o bɛ mara WeKan kɔnɔ, WeKan walanw kan. U kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ datugulen fo i k'a taamasiyɛn yan. U si t'a yɛrɛ ka sariya sɔrɔ: client bɛ don ni WeKan API token ye, ka se ka dɔrɔn ye ani ka dɔrɔn yɛlɛma min mɔgɔ in bɛ se ka ye ani ka yɛlɛma WeKan kɔnɔ. U bɛɛ mago bɛ WeKan REST API dayɛlɛlen na (WITH_API=true). Adɛrɛsi min bɛ kelen-kelen bɛɛ jukɔrɔ, client bɛ o de kɛ a ka server ye.
optional-api-trello: API min bɛ bɛn Trello ma
optional-api-trello-desc: Application ni script minnu sɛbɛnna Trello ka REST API kama (i n'a fɔ Trellinator) bɛ baara kɛ ni WeKan ye: walanw, lisitiw, karatiw, taamasiyɛnw, tɔndenw, hakilinaw ani sɛgɛsɛgɛli sɛbɛnw. Trello token ye WeKan API token ye. Ni i ye karati jɔsi, a bɛ mara WeKan kɔnɔ.
optional-api-jira: API min bɛ bɛn Jira ma
optional-api-jira-desc: Jira ka REST API v2 clientw bɛ baara kɛ ni WeKan ye: porozɛ ye walan ye (a ka key ye walan key ye), gɛlɛya ye karati ye (DEV-7), status ye lisiti ye, ani transition bɛ karati wuli. Ɲinini bɛ JQL nɔgɔman ta: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text ani ORDER BY. Don ni WeKan API token ye i n'a fɔ password. Ni i ye gɛlɛya jɔsi, a bɛ mara.
optional-api-github: API min bɛ bɛn GitHub ma
optional-api-github-desc: GitHub ka REST API gɛlɛyaw kama clientw bɛ baara kɛ ni WeKan ye: repository ye walan ye, gɛlɛya ye karati ye, ni taamasiyɛnw, sanfɛyɔrɔw (taamasiyɛn minnu ka waati laban bɛ yen), hakilinaw, ani dayɛlɛlen walima datugulen i n'a fɔ Tabali yeli / Bɔli sugandili kɔlɔsili kɔnɔ. Token ye WeKan API token ye.
optional-api-gitea: API min bɛ bɛn Gitea ma
optional-api-gitea-desc: Gitea ni Forgejo ka REST API gɛlɛyaw kama clientw bɛ baara kɛ ni WeKan ye, cogo kelen na ni API min bɛ bɛn GitHub ma: repository ye walan ye ani gɛlɛya ye karati ye. Token ye WeKan API token ye.
bots-none: Bɔti si tɛ yen fɔlɔ. Bɔti ye baarakɛla ye i yɛrɛ ka sɛriwɛri kan - AI ciden, CI baara, sikiripiti - walan nin bɛ kartiw di min ma.
bots-no-runs: Bɔti si tɛ baara la sisan.
bots-summary: %s bɛ baara la · %s bɛ i makɔnɔ

webhook-internal-hosts-desc: Webhook bɔtaw tɛ se ka se WeKan yɛrɛ ka ɲɔgɔndanjɔ kan adɛrɛsiw ma, walasa mɔgɔ si kana se ka walan dɔ ka webhook kɛ ka taa baarakɛcogo dɔ la min bɛ kɔnɔ. Yan, ɲɔgɔndanjɔ in kan host minnu bɛ se ka sɔrɔ webhookw fɛ, olu sɛbɛn - Node-RED, baro sɛriwɛri - kelen sira kelen kelen kan, i n'a fɔ tɔgɔ walima adɛrɛsi, ni bonda ye walasa ka o bonda dɔrɔn yamaruya. Lankolon: foyi. Siti ɲɛmɔgɔw dɔrɔn de bɛ se ka nin lisi in yɛlɛma.

email-bounces-description: WeKan bɛ min kɛ ni imɛli segintaw ye: ladɛrɛsi sɛbɛnnen jugu, imɛli bɔɔrɔ fanen, jaabi ko mɔgɔ tɛ biro la, spam kan ŋunuŋunu. Suguya kelen-kelen bɛɛ n'a ka baara bɛ, u bɛ kɛ ni a seginna o hakɛ ye.
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: Ladɛrɛsi tɛ yen: sɛbɛnni filli, jatebɔsɛbɛn jɔsilen, domɛni min ma dɔn.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: A ma se sisan: imɛli bɔɔrɔ fanen don, sɛriwɛri bɛ baara la. Siɲɛ caman tugu ɲɔgɔn kɔ dɔrɔn de bɛ kuma fɔ.
email-bounces-category-auto-reply-desc: Mɔgɔ tɛ biro la, lafiɲɛ walima tikɛ sisitɛmu jaabiw. Imɛli sera.
email-bounces-category-complaint-desc: Sɔrɔbaga ye imɛli taamasiyɛn ko spam.
email-bounces-ses-description: Amazon SES kɔnɔ, Bounce ni Complaint kunnafoniw, ani sɔrɔli sariya WeKan bɛ ci kɛ ladɛrɛsi min na, ci ka taa SNS kuma dɔ la, ka ladɛrɛsi nin sɛbɛn a la HTTPS fɛ:
email-bounces-ses-topics: SNS kuma ARN minnu bɛ sɔn, kelen sira kelen-kelen bɛɛ la

email-bounce-invalid-topic: O tɛ SNS kuma ARN ye.
email-bounces-providers-description: Ni WeKan bɛ ci bila nin baarakɛyɔrɔ dɔ fɛ, a yeelen, webhook ladɛrɛsi nin di baarakɛyɔrɔ ma a ka imɛli segintaw ni spam kan ŋunuŋunu kow kama, ka kile min b'a bolonɔ bila u la, walima gundo daɲɛ min i ye bila ladɛrɛsi la i n'a fɔ https://user:password@… walima ?secret=…, o bila yan
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: Baarakɛyɔrɔ yeelennen mago bɛ a ka bolonɔbila kile walima a ka gundo daɲɛ na.

activity-pub-desc: A datugulen don ka bɔ a daminɛ na. N'a dayɛlɛlen don, walan foroba bɛɛ bɛ se ka tugu ka bɔ Mastodon ni fediverse sɛrvɛri wɛrɛw la i n'a fɔ @board-<id> nin WeKan ka adrɛsi la, ani karti baara kuraw bɛ se a nɔfɛmɔgɔw ma. A ye kalan dɔrɔn ye: fediverse sɛrvɛri bɛ min ci, o si tɛ walan yɛlɛma, wa walan gundolenw tɛ jira abada.
caldav-sync-desc: Nin walan karti waati labanw bila donw kalandiriye dɔ kɔnɔ - Nextcloud Calendar walima CalDAV kalandiriye o kalandiriye. Waati laban min yɛlɛmana kalandiriye kɔnɔ, o bɛ segin karti kan. Aplikasiyɔn gundo daɲɛ kɛ, i yɛrɛ ta tɛ.
caldav-enabled: Waati labanw bɛn nin kalandiriye ma
caldav-invalid-url: Kalandiriye adrɛsi ka kan ka kɛ http:// walima https:// adrɛsi ye, baarakɛla tɔgɔ walima gundo daɲɛ tɛ min kɔnɔ.
caldav-not-linked: Fɔlɔ, kalandiriye adrɛsi mara ani bɛnni dayɛlɛ.
webdav-storage-description: Nɔrɔlenw mara foroko dɔ kɔnɔ WebDAV sɛrvɛri kan - Nextcloud Files, ownCloud walima wɛrɛ o wɛrɛ. Aplikasiyɔn gundo daɲɛ min dabɔra WeKan kama, o kɛ. WeKan yɛrɛ ka jɛɲɔgɔnya sɛrvɛri bɛ se ka kɛ yan, katuguni siti ɲɛmɔgɔ dɔrɔn de bɛ nin adrɛsi sigi.
sqrl-desc: A datugulen don ka kɔn. Ni a bɛ a la, donni ɲɛ bɛ SQRL di, ani tɔndenw bɛ u ka SQRL tɔgɔsɛbɛn fara a kan fɔlɔ Tɔnden labɛnw kɔnɔ. SQRL mago bɛ WeKan na https:// ladrɛsi kan.

sqrl-expired: Nin SQRL kode waati banna. A daminɛ kokura.
sqrl-sign-in-failed: Donni ni SQRL ye ma se ka kɛ.
sqrl-needs-https: SQRL mago bɛ WeKan na https:// ladrɛsi kan.
sqrl-description: Don ni i ka SQRL tɔgɔsɛbɛn ye gundo daɲɛ nɔ na. A fara a kan yan siɲɛ kelen ni i ka SQRL kiliyan ye; i bɛ se k'a bɔ yan waati o waati.
